scenes.plot: Amelia is trying on wedding dresses when she becomes distracted by a missed call from the principal of Queen's School. Her friend Cici notices her unease and gently inquires about her stress. Amelia reveals a career advancement opportunity, and her fiancé James reassures her of his support. The scene highlights Amelia’s struggle to balance her personal and professional aspirations.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Amelia’s internal conflict and the values of commitment and growth, while showcasing the support of her friends and partner.

chunk.text: Amelia stands in the fitting room, admiring the lace wedding dress in the mirror. Her phone buzzes on the small table beside her, and she hesitates before picking it up. A missed call from the principal. She looks at the message, then back at the dress. Cici, outside the room, notices her pause and asks, 'Hey, is everything okay?' Amelia takes a deep breath and says, 'I got an offer for a leadership position at the school, and I’m just trying to figure out if I can do both—this wedding and the new role.' James smiles from the bench and says, 'You’ve always balanced everything so well, Amelia. You’ll find a way to make it work.'
